controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Test enforcement of authentication, authorisation, per-tool permissions, and retrieval access boundaries across the AI system.

controls.title: Agent-Specific
controls.description: Test agentic behaviours including goal integrity, tool-permission boundaries, and multi-step autonomous action control.

controls.title: Availability
controls.description: Test resilience against resource exhaustion, rate-limit evasion, and denial-of-service conditions that degrade the AI service.

controls.title: Data Protection
controls.description: Test safeguards against leakage of training data, embeddings, credentials, and other sensitive content from the AI system.

controls.title: Input Handling
controls.description: Test resistance to prompt injection and adversarial inputs across every channel the model or agent processes.

controls.title: Logging & Monitoring
controls.description: Test that AI actions, anomalies, and abuse patterns are logged with sufficient detail for detection and forensic review.

controls.title: Model Behaviour
controls.description: Test the model for goal consistency, refusal robustness, hallucination rate, and behaviour under adversarial conditions.

controls.title: Output Handling
controls.description: Test that model-generated outputs, parameters, and citations are validated and safely handled by downstream consumers.

controls.title: Supply Chain
controls.description: Test the security of AI supply-chain components including models, datasets, vector stores, and third-party dependencies.
